page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr5s.24xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The system features 96 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8163 processors with x86_64 architecture operating at a frequency of 2.5 GHz. It contains 768.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU core.

The server does not include local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators. Network capability includes a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to this configuration by default.

Cost efficiency is tied to its high memory density per core, providing efficient resource allocation for workloads where memory demands surpass compute needs. Key architectural tradeoffs include reliance on external network-attached block storage for data persistence due to the absence of local disks.

This instance configuration is structured for memory-bound workloads, including large in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning applications, high-throughput caching tiers, and memory-intensive data analytics.
